Subject: Re: Urgent: Production errors & latency spike in us-west-az2

Investigating — preliminary findings below.

Observed behavior:
- Error type: mixed 502/504 and a rising 429 tail on high-QPS routes.
- Root hint: KV cache saturation + continuous batch starvation on the az2 fleet. KV cache hit-ratio dropped 38% and memory-pressure evictions spiked; requests that hit the cache saw queueing and then proxy 502s when instances hit soft limits.
- Autoscaler did not shift fast enough due to per-az cap locks and sticky routing. We also saw increased retry amplification from client side.

Immediate options (pros/cons):
A) Windowed failover (recommended initial move): shift 20% -> 50% traffic over 10 minutes to us-west-az1 and us-central, hold for 15 minutes to allow KV cache to stabilize, then gradual return. Pros: fastest way to reduce customer impact. Cons: risk of overload on target AZs if warmup not respected; possible transient 429s.
B) Targeted drain + cache purge in az2: lower risk of cross-region impact but could take 30–60 minutes to recover and cost customers more errors in the meantime.

Suggested immediate play (what I will run if approved):
1) Start a 10-minute canary: 10% traffic to us-west-az1 and us-central via routing policy.
2) Monitor P95 and 5xx for 2 minutes. If stable, step to 30% over next 5 minutes.
3) Hold for 15 minutes, then evaluate return ramp.

I've attached a short kvcache excerpt and the redwood runbook reference.

Attachments: [redwood_kvcache_excerpt.txt]

—Rishi

- Canary: 10% -> 30% -> hold (10 minute canary, step to 30% over 5 minutes)
- Hold duration: 15 minutes after reaching 30%
- Owners: Rishi (tech lead for steering), Connor (rollback / infra), Stephanie (customer comms)
- Communication plan: Stephanie to notify Verge SRE immediately with expected timeline and an apology credit offer if we see any additional errors during migration.

Immediate next steps (do not delay):
1) Rishi: start canary steering now and post updates every 5 minutes to this thread.
2) Connor: pre-stage capacity in us-west-az1/us-central, and prepare rollback policy (full stop and return within 2 minutes if P95 or 5xx deteriorate beyond existing).
3) Stephanie: send Verge the timeline and point of contact.

Link to runbook: https://redwood.app/runbooks/windowed-failover-v1 (internal)

I will escalate to exec Slack if the canary shows abnormalities. Good catch, team — move quickly.
